text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Summer's here, and it's bringing the<n>heat!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In order to gear up for the Sprinters<n>Stakes, Taiki
Shuttle is prepared to<n>take on any training
necessary.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With her determination at an all-time<n>high, the two of
us start summer<n>camp!
